questions: Does 'change one element to any other element' mean we can change it to any integer, or only to an integer already present in the array?
If the array length is odd, is the middle element considered for changes, or is it always left as is?
Should the function handle non-integer elements (e.g., floats, strings) or only integers as specified?
Is the goal to minimize the number of changes, or is any set of changes acceptable as long as the array becomes palindromic?
Are we allowed to change an element multiple times in the process, or does each change count as one operation on an original element?
Does the array need to remain an array of integers after changes, or can elements become other data types?
If the array is empty, what should be returned? (e.g., 0, None, or raise an error?)
Should the function modify the input array in-place, or is it read-only?
